recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14887 unless a future vocab decision reopens the broader design of UI/navigation filtering in ValueSet expansion.
issue_request: FHIR-14887 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification vocab change request from the STU3 ballot. It asked to generalize ExpansionProfile.excludeNotForUI because different code systems identify UI or not-for-UI concepts using different properties; the final decision required clearer documentation of how excludeNotForUI relates to ValueSet.expansion.contains.abstract and different code-system use cases rather than adding a generic property/value parameter.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14641, represented in git as f77fc64d65070801355d2681468555ecd7adc10c, which changed the then-authoritative ValueSet spreadsheet documentation for excludeNotForUI. Later source refactoring moved the authoritative operation definition to source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml.
additional_context: ExpansionProfile is no longer active in the current build; source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet active and records ExpansionProfile as dropped. The current ValueSet/$expand operation definition documents excludeNotForUI using CodeSystem notSelectable=true, nested contains with no code, nested contains with abstract=true, and the FHIR Specification generation practice. Later Published issue FHIR-30700 revisited the same parameter, retained its name, and approved the current notSelectable/no-code/abstract wording; FHIR-30700 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already carries the clarification needed for implementers, and adding a new property/value parameter or reverting to broader 2018 wording would conflict with the final FHIR-14887 disposition and later FHIR-30700 refinement.

related_jiras.note: Revisited the same ValueSet/$expand excludeNotForUI parameter, kept the existing name, and refined the description now present in active source; already audited on the combined branch.
